newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile industrial output rises 3.8 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Chile industrial output rises 3.8 pct in Nov.

text.p: Chilean industrial production rose 3.8 percent in November compared with the same month in 1995, with sales increasing 4.4 percent, the National Statistics Institute said.
Greatest increases in output were seen in the iron and steel industry, up 110 percent, publishing, up 16 percent, and oil refining, up 10 percent.
Declines were recorded in the production of tobacco, down 14 percent, textiles, down 6.6 percent, and chemical products, down six percent.
